description: This C# source file defines the EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory class, which is a specialized implementation of an Orleans stream provider adapter for testing purposes. It generates its own events instead of reading from Event Hubs, providing methods for initializing, generating partitions, handling stream placement, and executing commands related to stream management.

classes.name: EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing a test stream provider that generates its own events, with capabilities to initialize, execute commands, and manage stream placement.

classes.name: StreamRandomPlacementArg
classes.description: A serializable class representing arguments for randomly placing a stream into a queue, including the stream ID and a random number.

methods.name: EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with various configuration options and dependencies.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the adapter factory, setting the receiver factory.

methods.name: InitEventHubClient
methods.description: Override that does nothing, as this generator does not connect to EventHub.

methods.name: GetPartitionIdsAsync
methods.description: Generates mocked Event Hub partition IDs based on the configured partition count.

methods.name: EHGeneratorReceiverFactory
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specific Event Hub partition, using a data generator.

methods.name: RandomlyPlaceStreamToQueue
methods.description: Assigns a stream to a queue randomly based on a provided argument.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production for a specific stream across all receivers.

methods.name: GenerateEventHubPartitions
methods.description: Static method that creates partition IDs for Event Hubs.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command to manipulate stream placement or production.
